maps.name: Ember Rhythm
maps.intent: Learn to pump two rollers, carry that rhythm into a visible gap, then repeat with a quicker pop.
maps.signature: Pumping rhythm becomes flight timing; a broad tabletop teaches the motion before the first void.

stages.purpose: Teach two readable weight shifts without a failure gap.
Practice crest timing with continuous rollable ground.
One rounded crest prepares the first flight.
Spend learned momentum on a visible gap and long sloped catch.
Settle on the valley floor and rebuild speed gradually.
Repeat the timing in a shorter flight after a clear recovery.
Finish with a readable three-beat rhythm, then clear runout.

maps.name: Azure Terrace
maps.intent: Climb toward a visible terrace, rehearse an elevated catch, then reveal the skyline with one high spring.
maps.signature: A 10-unit spring lift unlocks an upper route; the final terraced descent releases the tension.

stages.purpose: Teach sustained throttle while the upper route enters view.
Rehearse reaching a higher catch before the cinematic lift.
Reset bike pitch and camera before the spring approach.
Reveal the 10-unit higher terrace through a tall coin-guided arc.
Reward the upper ramp line while preserving continuous ground fallback.
Descend in two readable steps after the skyline reveal.
Use the long deck as a final relaxed stunt before the finish.

maps.name: Fuse Halo
maps.intent: Teach curved takeoff, show the explosive connector and loop, then give the player a safe ground return.
maps.signature: One boosted one-use loop is the landmark; the connector disappears only after full-bike clearance.

stages.purpose: Establish stable pumping before curved takeoff.
Teach leaning into a smooth rising curve and matching the catch.
Bring the halo into view and settle at its entry elevation.
Commit to the optional connector, boost into inversion, then land on the revealed fallback.
Let suspension and camera settle after the loop return.
Offer an elevated reward line with safe ground underneath.
A small final skip echoes the opening scoop without another inversion.

maps.name: Skyline Courier
maps.intent: Teach the high bridge route, then use an optional crest barrel for a short aerial delivery onto a readable catch.
maps.signature: A barrel-assisted skybridge pop is the centerpiece; the ground route remains continuous below it.

stages.purpose: Introduce climbing onto and leaving a broad roof-like plateau.
Teach the high reward line over an unobstructed ground fallback.
Return to ground level and normalize speed before the barrel.
Use the crest barrel for an optional forward-up pop, descending onto the bridge return.
Leave room after barrel landing for a zero-speed restart.
Carry the learned landing pitch into a lower road.
Finish on a wide, rollable deck with no further impulse objects.

maps.name: Broken Horizon
maps.intent: Build a sense of increasing horizontal distance, then let a spring carry the bike across the central canyon.
maps.signature: A 36-unit void and long eight-coin spring arc create the widest single reveal so far.

stages.purpose: Keep the bike low through three troughs before opening the horizon.
Teach identifying takeoff and landing banks on a small crossing.
Show the distant destination from an early crest with time to settle.
Cross the 36-unit canyon in one deliberate camera sweep with a broad catch.
Return camera and suspension to ground flow after the long flight.
Echo the canyon crossing as a shorter manually controlled flight with an extended catch.

maps.name: Basalt Descent
maps.intent: Teach braking and descending alignment in successive lower catch basins, separated by stabilization shelves.
maps.signature: A downhill route built around horizontal drops and sloped catches; braking, rather than boosts, sets the pace.

stages.purpose: Reach the crater rim with an intermediate shelf that settles pitch.
Teach rolling off a horizontal lip into a generous sloped catch.
Give a visible braking cue before the long step-down.
Use a long descending flight to reward deliberate pitch control.
Settle in a broad basin before the deeper drop.
Signal speed reduction before the lower lip.
Apply the learned drop technique to greater vertical separation.
Two low rollers restore a calm forward rhythm.
An optional descending bridge resolves the downhill theme above safe ground.

maps.name: Quarry Cadence
maps.intent: Alternate deliberate low-speed ledges with a faster optional loop so speed control becomes the central skill.
maps.signature: Curb, double curb, elevated catch, then a wide explosive halo; each speed regime has its own reset.

stages.purpose: Introduce one intentional ledge and a broad wheel-settling shelf.
Allow a clean approach before repeating the ledge skill.
Repeat the weight transfer twice, then checkpoint on the stable shelf.
Transition from careful ledges into forward momentum.
Combine forward drive and front-wheel clearance over a visible elevated catch.
Use the plateau to reveal the loop and normalize its entry.
Offer a wide optional inversion; two branch-only boosts support its larger radius.
Provide a clear ground recovery after loop exit.
Finish with a familiar rollable shape after the speed contrast.

maps.name: Cloud Observatory
maps.intent: Make the upper destination the visual goal, reach it through a tall spring reveal, then explore its raised bridge.
maps.signature: A 14-unit lift leads to a raised roller bridge with an optional barrel reprise.

stages.purpose: Establish airborne alignment before the much taller cinematic transfer.
Climb toward the visible observatory silhouette.
Frame both platform heights and the apex of a 14-unit lift.
Give a wide upper plateau for camera recentering before the bridge.
A restrained pop from the last raised crest rewards controlled bridge speed; ground remains available.
Descend gradually after the aerial reprise without another launch object.
Echo the raised rollers safely at ground level before the finish.

maps.name: Redline Viaduct
maps.intent: Build speed through compression, spend it on a tall optional loop, recover, then test one long manual gap.
maps.signature: A tall explosive halo and long-clear gap form two separated peaks, with a downhill bridge between them.

stages.purpose: Teach early acceleration out of a long rising bowl exit.
Read a longer takeoff and descending catch before the loop approach.
Settle the suspension before entering the boost branch.
Use two connector boosts to support a tall optional inversion and visible ground return.
Separate the loop speed regime from the later manual gap.
Use a descending high line to rebuild readable forward flow.
A long visible manual crossing with a wide catch is the final exam after full recovery.
One final reward marks the calm roller cooldown.

maps.name: Crown Relay
maps.intent: Recombine Cinder Crown's features into a relay: manual gap, one-use inversion, upper terrace, barrel flourish and final wide crossing.
maps.signature: Two spring transfers with different purposes are separated by an upper bridge and recovery; the final crossing gets the largest coin budget.

stages.purpose: Two distinct crests establish the relay rhythm.
Complete a manual gap before committing to the optional stunt branch.
Reveal the loop landmark and settle its approach.
Hold the optional loop longer, clear the explosive connector and recover on the fallback.
Normalize velocity before the spring replaces it.
A short vertical reveal transfers the route onto the upper terrace.
Offer a brief optional barrel flourish on the upper bridge with a clear landing.
Separate barrel landing from the long spring trigger and preview the far bank.
A 28-unit crossing resolves the relay in one wide camera sweep.
Descend into an extended empty finish boulevard after the last checkpoint.
